about_the_game:
Versus – Original Soundtrack 🎶

Relive the intensity of Versus beyond the battlefield with the official soundtrack DLC.
This collection features 26 original tracks that capture the energy, mystery, and atmosphere of the game.

From high-adrenaline combat themes to darker, atmospheric pieces, the Versus Original Soundtrack lets you experience the emotions of the game anytime, anywhere.

🎧 DLC Content:

  • 26 original tracks composed exclusively for Versus.

  • 1hr 55mins of music.

  • Delivered in high-quality .mp3 format.

  • A unique blend of industrial rock, electronic, and experimental sounds.

⚠️ This DLC contains the official soundtrack only. It does not include additional in-game content for Versus.
